sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, which must be 
performed every five years as indicated by Y5 in above title block.

The gland exhauster system prevents sealing steam from escaping past the outer 
shaft packing rings to atmosphere at each end of the turbine rotor by 
maintaining a slight vacuum in the outer leak off chamber between the end 
packing rings, the system continuously removes a mixture of this sealing steam 
and air ( which tends to enter the turbine along the rotor shaft ) and 
discharges the resultant condensate to a suitable drain.

As shown in figure1 the basic system consists of a condensate collecting tank, 
motor driven air blower, and water spray chamber connected to the leak off 
piping in the packing glands.

sections.text: التفكيك
Move the unit by lifting under the steel base.
Preferably machine should be set on a level floor in a clean dry place.
Remove shipping skids and set unit on base provided four under the corners
Two under the center of the I beam base members.
Remove shipping cover and connect piping.
Use extreme caution to prevent foreign material entering blower.
Use flexible connection between unit and piping system.

A dial indicator is the best device for checking alignment for most couplings 
 a straight edge may be used on top and side of coupling.

قم برفع أو خفض المحرك عن طريق تعديل الرقائق أو بطرق جانبية للعمود لإزالة كليهما 
 اختلال متوازي وزاوي (لا يتجاوز 1/64 بوصة).
قم بإزالة المنفاخ العلوي مع تمديد العمود لأعلى.
Remove # 9 bearing cap.
Remove # 20 and # 21 locknut and lockwasher.
قم بإزالة مبيت المحمل رقم 11 والمحمل رقم 14 وقاذفة الشحوم معًا.
Remove # 26 or # 27 labyrinth.
Remove # 5 & # 6 tie rods.
قم بإزالة رأس المدخل رقم 16.
Remove # 18 & # 19 locknut and lockwasher.
Remove # 1 impeller.
Remove # 3 intermediate section.
Turn shaft back into horizontal position.

Remove cap screws holding # 12 bearing housing to # 17 outlet head and # 26 or 
 # 27 labyrinth to # 17 outlet head and slip # 17 head off shaft.

Remove free bearing (drive end) - Pull coupling half do not knock or pry it 
 off shaft.
Remove bearing cap bearing locknut and bearing lockwasher
Remove cap screw holding bearing housing to inlet head.

Pull bearing housing, bearing, and grease slinger off shaft attach puller to 
 housing.

Remove bearing from housing. If necessary, use extreme care and knock bearing 
 out from back of housing.

قم بإزالة محمل الدفع (الطرف المقابل لمحرك الأقراص) - قم بإزالة الأجزاء التالية 
 الترتيب:
 * غطاء المحمل رقم 10.
 * Bearing locknut # 22 and bearing lockwasher # 23.
 * Bearing housing # 12, bearing # 8 , and grease slinger # 
 15.
Adjusting leakage flow ( spray chamber ) refer to figure (3,4):

Connect a manometer to one of the pressure taps in the leak off piping (refer 
 to the diagram of the gland exhauster system included in the descriptive 
 portion of this manual)

Loosen gland nut (5) on the same side of the chamber as the manometer 
 connection and close damper vane (3) until a slight steam flow from the rotor 
 shaft is noted record the vacuum reading at this setting.

Open damper vane (3) until an additional (6 inch) of water vacuum is obtained 
 then tighten gland nut (5).

sections.text:
حَشد 
(راجع الشكل 2)
Apply good cleaning for all air blower parts.

Bolt bearing housing (11) firmly to inlet head (16) and tighten the cap screws 
 evenly.
Firmly against the shaft shoulder

Slide the new bearing into place in housing (7) if necessary, tap it carefully 
 into place but take care not to hit the balls or retainer.
Install lockwasher (21) and locknut (20) and tighten firmly .
Coat the bearing balls and retainer sparingly with clean grease.

Fill bearing cap (9) no more than one half full of grease and assemble the 
 cap to the bearing housing make sure the shaft turns freely by hand.
Install the coupling half on the blower shaft.

Tap the coupling half into place carefully with a lead hammer and rotate the 
 shaft while tapping to distribute the load on the thrust bearing.
Install the drive motor
